result.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
result.summary: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with their environments through complete assistant turns while generating each action token by token. We observe that critic values vary primarily across turns, motivating optimization anchored at turns with finer credit allocation among tokens. We propose Multiscale Policy Optimization (MPO), combining Multiscale Advantage Estimation (MAE) and turn-level importance sampling to align credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale. Extensive experiments across search, tool-use, and automation tasks with 4B and 30B-A3B models demonstrate consistent gains over strong RL baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文观察到长时程 LLM 智能体的 critic 值主要在整轮（turn）之间变化，于是提出多尺度策略优化 MPO，用多尺度优势估计配合 turn 级重要性采样，把信用分配与策略更新对齐到 turn 尺度，并在搜索、工具调用和自动化任务上以 4B 与 30B-A3B 模型验证其优于强 RL 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「优势主要跨 turn 变化、token 内需重新分配信用」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步与 token 级贡献分配、轨迹监督粒度提供可核查的训练线索，但原文并非视觉多模态研究，迁移需人工判断。
